name: Akshay Mane
text: If you want to master your body mechanics, calisthenics is the best thing you can do to yourself and this is the best place you can learn it. I have been training under coach shiva for 4 months now and the knowledge he has is incredible. I have unlocked so many skills with his help. All other coaches are also very good. And also the community is crazy, very supportive people and positive vibes only in the gym. +1 point for the view. It is beautiful you should visit sometimes.

name: Devyanshu Gautam
text: I’ve been training here for 4 months, and it’s been an amazing experience! The coaching is excellent, the progress is real, and the community is super motivating. If you’re in Hyderabad and want to start calisthenics the right way, this is the place to be. So glad I joined!

name: yashwanth kottala
text: Training under Aman has been an incredible experience. In just 3 months of personal training, I achieved skills I once thought were impossible muscle ups, handstands, front and back levers, human flag, and more. His coaching is highly structured, detail-oriented, and focused on longterm progress rather than shortcuts. Aman knows exactly when to push, when to correct, and how to build both physical strength and mental discipline. Beyond the skills, he helped me develop confidence, consistency, and a stronger mindset. I’m truly grateful for his guidance and would highly recommend him to anyone serious about calisthenics.

name: sivarama krishna
text: I’ve been training at this calisthenics gym for a while now, and it’s been an amazing experience. The trainers are extremely knowledgeable, supportive, and genuinely invested in everyone’s progress. They focus heavily on proper form and technique. The workout routines are well-structured, challenging, and never boring. Each session is thoughtfully planned to progressively build strength, mobility, and endurance. Whether you’re a beginner or more advanced, they scale the exercises perfectly to your level.

name: k.nagarjuna Raju
text: I’ve been training here for 4 months, and it’s been an amazing experience! The coaching is excellent, the progress is real. One thing I truly appreciate about Coach Shiva is the way he teaches and corrects postures so precisely and clearly. And the place itself is amazing — the morning sessions feel magical, like the sunrise is watching you rise
